summary: This directory provides the structural representation and analysis models for package.json configuration files, enabling the parsing and definition of dependency specifications, export mappings, and import configurations used in a project environment.
responsibilities: Define schema interfaces for core package.json fields
Categorize and identify dependency types within a package
Model path mapping for export and import configurations
Analyze and aggregate package metadata into a structured object
relationships: PackageJsonAnalysis aggregates various dependencies, export entries, and import entries into a single cohesive model.
PackageDependency defines the classification of dependencies based on their source and usage context within the configuration.
PackageExportEntry and PackageImportEntry describe mapping logic between source paths and target destinations.
designDecisions: Use of TypeScript interfaces to enforce schema structure for configuration data
Enumeration of dependency types to provide type-safe classification
Modular decomposition of complex configuration fields into dedicated interface types
